nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid Tinted SPF 50+

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin describes a dewy, not-fully-matte finish without extra shine, while another with combination-oily skin found the formula greasy and pore-clogging.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one prone to eczema, report good results but recommend applying a moisturizer first since the formula can cling to dry patches.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin in her early thirties found the formula too greasy and pore-clogging to wear comfortably under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, though one reviewer says it triggered a rosacea flare-up within a minute of application.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone skin, report no breakouts from this sunscreen; one reviewer with combination skin found it clogged her pores.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the sunscreen flared her skin almost immediately, while sensitive-skin reviewers elsewhere report no reaction at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers managing melasma report the sunscreen helped keep it from worsening, and one says it prevented her freckles from darkening further.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: one describes a dewy but not oily finish, while another found the formula too greasy for daily wear under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Orange or too-dark tint on fair skin
Disappears invisibly on deeper or tan skin tones
Water-resistant, holds up in heat or sweat

extraits.texte: This is awful! Ignoring the fact that is as orange as a the fruit, it flared up my rosacea in less than a minute. 100% returning it. Save the trouble!

Opinion on this would differ for different skin types but for mine, combination early 30's - product was super greasy, color is wildly out of color range and still needs to be used underneath everyday make up because it gives off the same ultra shiny appearance of spf. I would rather just wear my normal spf underneath my make up because the oil in this doesn't work well with my combination skin and makes my pores feel clogged.

If you're a brown girl with medium deep skin, including olive undertones, this tinted sunscreen is perfect! It somehow completely disappears but still provides nice coverage. No castiness- it's completely undetectable in that sense. I wear this on days I don't feel like wearing foundation. I'll add brows, mascara, lip balm, and call it a day. I live in a super dry and cold climate so it's not as deeply moisturizing as something like Tower 28 (which I also love but is more makeup-y and is only spf 30) so I like to use it over a light moisturizer in the winter, unlike Tower 28 which I'd wear by itself. I wear this alone in warmer months though. Both are good if you have eczema and try to stick to mineral sunscreens which we all know often suck. It's so great to finally have a great mineral spf 50 option as a brown girl with dry skin!!

This has been the best SPF I've ever used. It has THE perfect color for tan skintones. The texture is light enough where it doesn't feel heavy, but it does add some coverage. I love wearing this underneath my make up or as my makeup. I have acne prone skin and this has never caused a breakout or irritation. I love it!! Give it a try if you are in the market for a new mineral sunscreen and you have a tanner skintone.

This is effective for the melasma on my upper lip and looks good on my olive skin. After researching the best sunscreen for melasma, I bought this Avène product because it contains two key features: minimum SPF 50 and blue light protection.

extraits.titre: The best sunscreen out there for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I LOVE THIS STUFF! I've been using this for the past like 3-4 months after having a bad facial dermatitis breakout. I read online that sunscreen is super important to not make the condition worse, but I always have issues with sunscreen because of my very sensitive skin, and being prone to breakouts. This sunscreen has changed the game because I DO NOT break out ever from this AND it's tinted! I always mix it with my regular moisturizer since it's more orange colored to make it more skin color! Love this stuff genuinely!!!
